finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 3 consecutive years

summary: SNB reported record Q2 2026 net income of SAR 6.6B; revenue beat estimates by 5.69% at $10.58B, though EPS of $0.98 missed forecast by 1.02%
First-half net income rose 7% YoY to SAR 13B; return on tangible equity reached 16.9% with cost-to-income ratio of 25.6% and negative cost of risk
Management lowered 2026 financing growth guidance to mid-single digits, prioritizing profitable growth over volume expansion amid measured lending
Full-year ROTE guidance maintained at 16-17%; cost of risk outlook improved to 10-20 bps; interim dividend of SAR 1.15/share declared with 50%+ payout ratio
Stock surged 4.6% to $40.34 post-earnings; executives cited strong H2 outlook driven by Expo, World Cup projects, and SME activity growth
